title: Longest Palindromic Substring
description:
Given a nonempty string `s`, return its longest palindromic substring. If several longest substrings exist, return the one with the smallest starting index.

## Examples

```text
Input: s = "babad"
Output: "bab"
```

```text
Input: s = "cbbd"
Output: "bb"
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= s.length <= 1000`
- `s` contains only digits and English letters.
